title: 18_100754_general_1946-7_vol_2
doc_notes: This document is a collection of internal U.S. Air Force and Air Materiel Command correspondence from 1946-1947 regarding the investigation of 'Flying Discs' and the establishment of Project SIGN.

incidents.summary: Photographs taken by Mary L. Herren in the vicinity of Jefferson, Oregon, showing objects in the sky.
incidents.explanation: Marks on photographs believed to be defects in film, paper, or camera.
incidents.quote: The uniformity of the markings would tend to indicate that the camera or film used to take these pictures was possibly defective.

incidents.summary: Flying disc incident reported in Alaska.
incidents.quote: A brief statement was made in a recent intelligence report from Hq, USAF, AC/AS-2, regarding a flying disc incident in Alaska in September.

incidents.summary: Alleged flying saucer flight sighting by a radar station in Japan.
incidents.quote: It is requested that this office be furnished all available information concerning an alleged "Flying Saucer" flight sighting made by a radar station in Japan.
